chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام performed hajj on a she-camel of his forty times, and he never struck her with a whip.

key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام treat his camel during hajj?
ai.summary: This report describes the conduct of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام during hajj and highlights his mercy toward his riding animal. It reflects an ethical model of avoiding harm and oppression even toward beasts under one’s control.
